sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.UserId AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS savedCartCount, MIN(ad.Name) AS firstNameAsc, MAX(ad.Name) AS firstNameDesc, MIN(q.qty) AS firstQuantityAsc, MAX(q.qty) AS firstQuantityDesc, MIN(uq.Name) AS uniqueCartName FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ad ON ad.OrderId = o.OrderId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(op.Quantity) AS qty FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderProduct op WHERE op.OrderId = o.OrderId AND op.IsAddOn = @notAddOn) q OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ua.Name FROM dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail ua WHERE ua.OrderId = o.OrderId AND ua.Name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT xo.OrderId FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder xo INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOrderAdditionalDetail xa ON xa.OrderId = xo.OrderId WHERE xo.UserId = o.UserId AND xo.ClassId = o.ClassId AND xo.PortalId = o.PortalId AND xo.OrderId <> o.OrderId AND CHARINDEX(ua.Name, xa.Name) > @zero) ORDER BY ua.Name) uq WHERE oc.ClassCode = @savedCartClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) GROUP BY o.UserId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) >= @minSavedCarts AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) <= @maxSavedCarts AND MIN(uq.Name) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.UserId
